About: Interrogation questions (Questions.cs). cat: What / When / Where / Why (three each is what the menu is made for). need: fear over his temper's line before he'll answer. odds: + / - on his chance. lies: can he lie (a lie is still shown as ? intel, sometimes a trap). requires: gang named boss officer camps kin (joined by &). answer: orders wants bossnature catch news holedup stores people past worstgrudge bargain (and the older single ones: ride alone habit funeral shakeup camp hideout treasury supplies). requires 'news': his outfit has a burying or a shake-up heir to tell of; 'funeral': a burying. Built-in rows missing from this file are added by Id unless listed in Removed.

Rows.Text: "What are your orders? What's the outfit planning?"
"What kind of man is your boss?"
"When can I catch your boss? Where?"
"What's going on in the outfit? Anything coming?"
"Where do they keep the money? The guns and feed?"
"Your family. Your friends. Where are they?"
"Why do you ride with these men?"
"Who wants me dead the most? Why?"
"Give me one reason to let you live."
